about: Usability check for the MCP server, after the tool-design rules in the MCP skill. Ten read-only questions, each with one answer checked by exact match. A fresh agent answers them with only this server's tools, reached through ask.mjs against the data serve.mjs sets up.
pass_mark: 8 of 10 correct, with no failure caused by a misleading tool description

questions.question: How many snippets do the person's own (local) files hold in total, counting only the files that can be read? Answer with a number.
One of the person's own files cannot be read as YAML. What is its file name? Answer with the file name only.
A snippet has the label "Friendly goodbye". What exact text does it expand to? Answer with the text only.
questions.answer: Thanks for reaching out. Have a great day!

questions.question: The snippet triggered by ;sig ends with a name that comes from a variable defined once for its whole file. What name is that? Answer with the name only.
What date format does the snippet triggered by :today use? Answer with the format string only.
The form snippet triggered by :meet has one field with a fixed list of choices. How many choices are there, and which is last? Answer as: N, Name
In catalog.yml one snippet expands to a much longer text than all the others. What is its position in the file, counting from 0? Answer with a number.
Two team repositories are connected. One of them offers a package that runs commands. What is that package called, and how many packages does its repository offer in all? Answer as: name, N
Both connected team repositories offer a package named goodbyes. How many snippets does each of the two hold? Answer with the smaller number first, as: N, M
In the installed team package, the file escalations.yml holds three snippets. What does the third one expand to? Answer with the text only.
